channel.title: HPCC Service Status
channel.description: We'll post information about ICER's system downtimes, updates, new features, and other information for the ICER user community here.

item.title: Nodes down -- UPDATED 8/24
item.description:
UPDATE - Some nodes have been brought back online. 12 GPU nodes are still down and are actively being worked on by system administrators.

After yesterday’s maintenance, some compute nodes are not available for job scheduling. This is primarily affecting nodes with GPUs. Jobs requesting GPUs will likely queue for longer than usual or, depending on constraints, will stay in the queue until nodes are returned to service.

Our system administrators are working on this and will return nodes to service as soon as possible. Updates will be posted here.

item.title: Globus Down
item.description:
2026-08-20 4:45pm - Issue with Globus has been resolved and back online.

Globus experienced problems during summer maintenance today and is currently offline. We will continue to work on it.

item.title: Research Space Storage Outage
item.description: The file system manager for research spaces on the HPCC has failed and is being recovered. Jobs that were reading or writing to research spaces at the time may have failed. Please contact us if you notice any issues.

item.title: Research Filesystem Maintenance Wednesday 08/12/26 to Thursday 8/20/26
item.description: Beginning Wednesday, August 12th, we will be updating the research file system. No outage is anticipated; however, you may notice periodic slowdowns as components of the file system are rebalanced and rebooted. This work is scheduled to be completed during our summer maintenance window on Thursday, August 20, and this blog will be updated once the upgrade is complete.

item.title: Home Filesystem Maintenance Friday 08/14/26 - RESOLVED
item.description:
RESOLVED: 8/14/2026 - The home file system has been successfully upgraded.

On Friday, August 14th, at 7AM, an update will be applied to the home file system. No outage or performance impacts are anticipated. This blog will be updated once the upgrade is complete.

item.title: Dev-amd24-h200 Driver Updates - RESOLVED
item.description:
RESOLVED: 8/10/26 - At 6:45 AM upgrades were completed and the node returned to service.

On Monday, August 10th, 2026 we will be upgrading the Nvidia GPU drivers on dev-amd24-h200. At approximately 6:00 am, the node will be rebooted to enable the new drivers. Multiple reboots may be required and will be conducted without prior notification if necessary. Upon completion, this notice will be updated.
If you have any questions or encounter any issues, please contact us.

item.title: Tuning FairShare Priority Calculation - UPDATED 7/14/26
item.description:
UPDATED 7/14/26: We have finalized a new configuration for FairShare priority!

This new configuration differs in two important ways from the prior configuration:

  1. Individual GPU types are now weighted differently for FairShare usage calculations, e.g. a V100 GPU now counts only half as much as an H200 GPU. Previously, all GPUs were weighted the same.
  2. The amount of usage required to reduce the FairShare priority factor has greatly increased. It now takes roughly two days of sustained use of ~1000 cores or 40 GPUs to reduce the factor to zero. This gives a boost to FairShare priority for users with moderate usage relative to those with higher usage. Previously, moderate usage would reduce FairShare priority to zero and no priority advantage existed for moderate usage users over those with high usage.

You may notice changes to job wait times following this update. If you have any questions about this change, please contact us. For more information about FairShare and other factors that affect job priority, please refer to our documentation.

item.title: HPCC Scheduled Maintenance
item.description:
HPCC has completed the summer maintenance. Everything should be running in full production. Fill out a ticket if you notice any problems.

The HPCC will be unavailable on Thursday, August 20th starting at 5AM for regularly scheduled maintenance. No jobs will run during this time.

Jobs that will not be completed before this date will not begin until after maintenance is complete. For example, if you submit a four day job three days before the maintenance outage, your job will be postponed and will not begin to run until after maintenance is completed.

If you have any questions, please contact us

item.title: Network Mounts Restarting on AMD24
item.description: Due to recent security updates, we will be remounting all file systems on AMD24 nodes immediately. Jobs reading or writing data during this window may be interrupted. We can work with you for priority boosts if your running jobs are time dependent. Sorry for any inconvenience. Please contact us if you have any questions

item.title: Major OnDemand Portal Update
item.description:
ICER’s OnDemand portal has been updated to version 4.2! This update introduces several new features, including:

  • An option for interactive session notifications
  • A new System Status application to view overall cluster resource utilization
  • The ability to save, edit, and delete interactive application settings
  • An updated file editor interface
  • The display of both requested cores and GPUs on session cards
  • The ability to download session information as a zip file to attach to a support request

If you have any questions about this update or encounter any issues, please contact us.
